timing: All trace capture and serialization are outside the unchanged ordinary timed body.
sunk_work: Candidate representative distances are counted when first paid and reused. Graph decisions may pay estimator representatives, but never consume auxiliary rows. Recorded action cost excludes those sunk representative distances.
h3_reserve: H3 planning conservatively reserves a full descriptor signature scan and one hypothetical child representative. Actual H2 tail comparison uses cached signature/representative metadata and actual row length.
selection: Each family first screens prospective cost/gain against graph, then uses native nearest-parent vector distance; family winners compete on remaining unpaid cost/gain. Graph wins cost ties. Spatial ties use row ID.
